name: Points, Lines and Ready-made Titles
description: You are given n distinct points on a plane with integral coordinates. For each point you can either draw a vertical line through it, draw a horizontal line through it, or do nothing. You consider several coinciding straight lines as a single one. How many distinct pictures you can get? Print the answer modulo 10 9 + 7 .
input_specification: The first line contains single integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 10 5 ) — the number of points. n lines follow. The ( i + 1 )-th of these lines contains two integers x i , y i ( - 10 9 ≤ x i , y i ≤ 10 9 ) — coordinates of the i -th point. It is guaranteed that all points are distinct.
output_specification: Print the number of possible distinct pictures modulo 10 9 + 7 .
approach_summary: Precompute 2^k ancestor jumps up[u][k] and node depths in O(N log N). Compute LCA and path aggregates in O(log N) per query.
